answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a verifiable stake that is costly to forge: a new agent must lock collateral and earn attestations from established peers before it can transact. Like a crystal lattice, each attestation links identities into a structure where one bad node cannot silently multiply — a cipher-signed history makes every copy traceable, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, and the network can slash the whole cluster at once.
